ancestor.reason: Prior V4 prequery collided with UDM-exposed repositories. Never rewrite it; a new source-blind universe starts here.

hypothesis: Can prequalified, source-neutral observation methods be chosen by their typed applicability on genuinely unfamiliar native failing source, and does a licensed method actually repair the protected obligation?

metadata_rule.order: GitHub issue-search created ascending, PR number ascending for ties
metadata_rule.first_per_repo: First PR in fixed returned order meeting constraints; never choose by native outcome.
metadata_rule.production: Exactly one modified Python file under src/, not under tests/
metadata_rule.tests: Exactly one modified path under tests/ whose basename begins test and ends .py
metadata_rule.decline: Any config/build lock/CI/tox/setup dependency file changes, any other Python file changes outside the named pair, inaccessible or unpinned Git parent/head.
metadata_rule.metadata_projection: Only immutable repo, PR number, merge SHA, premerge first-parent SHA, author head SHA, selected file paths and timestamp are emitted. GitHub REST response may contain patches; discard them inside the metadata worker and do not log or transmit source text.
metadata_rule.roles: First 3 eligible repos, in source-blind order, sequential training admission; fourth SEALED_FUTURE until genuine training improvement has warrant
metadata_rule.shortfall: UNKNOWN_POOL_INCOMPLETE; no source access, no post-hoc substitutions
metadata_rule.original_native_failure_rule: Under source-owned original tests and dependencies, require >=1 original author assertion node actually called and failed, zero collection errors, zero affected skips; choose first admissible training in order; fail closed if no qualified failure.

frozen_choice_rule.decision: Inspect only immutable original source+head test+native observation after training admission. Ask each original byte-pinned method for typed applicability, without target-specific grammar changes. Exactly one applicable method -> execute it; zero -> UNKNOWN_NO_APPLICABLE_METHOD; two -> UNKNOWN_CHOICE unless a precommitted independent consequence separates them.

comparator_boundary.baseline: Original unchanged operations under same native time and matched source evidence
comparator_boundary.ledger: Fully informed original executable ledger and candidate inventory (not a handicapped memory)
comparator_boundary.agent: Actual source/test-capable coding agent with equivalent budget; if unavailable G4 remains UNKNOWN
comparator_boundary.comparative_requirement: No exclusive advantage unless all actual matched comparators execute and full costs are charged.
comparator_boundary.warrant: Training FAIL/PASS x2/withdrawal FAIL/restore PASS, then heldout future source-distinct native causal gain over unchanged method. Absent gate, G2 UNKNOWN.

anti_contamination: Never read source/tests/patch bodies before role freeze
Never open SEALED_FUTURE if training has no certified repair
Never rewrite old V4 prequery or earlier RED experiments
Already-exposed AnyIO/attrs/tox/Werkzeug are calibration, not fresh tasks
Metadata selection is not developmental learning
All methods are engineer supplied; selection is not autonomous creation of a new meta-language
No upstream writes; no secrets in untrusted native worker
